clips.prompt: A martial artist in a fighting stance bounces lightly on the balls of the feet, fists raised in front of the face, weight shifting from foot to foot.
A martial artist in a fighting stance with fists raised steps forward slowly in a straight line, keeping the guard up.
A martial artist in a fighting stance with fists raised steps backward slowly in a straight line, keeping the guard up.
A martial artist in a fighting stance crouches, jumps straight up high with the knees tucked, and lands back in the fighting stance.
A martial artist in a fighting stance drops into a low crouch with knees deeply bent and both fists raised to guard the face, and holds the crouch.
A martial artist in a fighting stance blocks, raising both forearms in front of the face and bracing the body, and holds the block.
A martial artist in a fighting stance throws a fast straight left jab at head height and pulls the fist back to guard.
A boxer in a fighting stance with both feet planted on the ground throws a powerful rising right uppercut punch with the right fist, then returns to guard. Both feet stay on the ground.
A martial artist in a fighting stance throws a fast combination of four punches, left jab, right cross, left hook, right uppercut, then returns to guard.

A standing fighter grabs the shoulders of an opponent in front with both hands, pulls them close and swings them around to the side with a strong twist of the torso, staying upright on both feet the whole time.
A martial artist in a fighting stance staggers back from a heavy hit to the face, head snapping back, then recovers the guard.
A martial artist in a fighting stance is knocked down by a heavy blow and falls backward onto the back, then lies still on the ground.
A fighter stands tall and raises both arms high above the head in victory, fists clenched.
A martial artist in a fighting stance throws a spinning roundhouse kick with the right leg at head height and lands back in the stance.
A martial artist in a fighting stance lunges forward with a long step and drives a straight right punch at chest height, then recovers the stance.
A large heavy fighter leaps up, raises both fists overhead, and slams them down onto the ground while landing in a deep squat.
A large heavy fighter raises the right fist high overhead and swings it down hard in a hammer blow in front of the body.
A warrior holding a long spear with both hands at the waist makes a quick short forward thrust with the spear and pulls it back.
A warrior holding a long spear with both hands makes a deep spear thrust lunge forward, extending both arms, then steps back.
A warrior holding a long spear with both hands spins the spear around the body and finishes with a long lunging thrust forward.
A nimble fighter holding a short knife in the right hand makes a quick forward slash across the body and returns to a crouched stance.
A nimble fighter darts forward and makes a rapid flurry of crisscross slashes with both hands, then hops back into a crouched stance.
A knight holding a sword in the right hand and a shield on the left arm makes a quick forward sword slash and returns to guard.
A knight raises a sword high overhead with the right hand and brings it down in a powerful overhead slash, then returns to guard.
A knight holding a sword makes a full spinning sword slash, turning all the way around, and finishes with a forward cut.
A knight blocks by raising a shield on the left forearm in front of the body and bracing behind it, holding the block.
